declarations.docstring: An element of the monoid algebra selected by a partition.
A product with the two partition-indexed elements vanishes when the indicated dominance relation fails.
A second element of the monoid algebra selected by a partition.
Multiplication by the embedded member leaves the primed partition-indexed element unchanged.
Distinct partitions give subtypes for which the displayed linear equivalence type is empty.
Inserting a permutation into the product yields zero under the stated failure of dominance.
An embedded member acts on the partition-indexed element through its permutation sign.
The partition-indexed product annihilates values from the displayed subtype when dominance fails.
The partition-indexed product is the product of the two displayed partition-indexed elements.
The square of the displayed partition-indexed product is nonzero over a characteristic-zero field.
